judged_text: The function unconditionally replaces a missing refresh_token with the placeholder string "refresh_token" before the parsed result is persisted to prisma.credential by callers. In sharing mode, minimumTokenResponseSchema (see above) never yields a refresh_token, so every refresh overwrites the user's stored real refresh_token with the literal "refresh_token"; the next refresh attempt (and any fallback to the provider's real endpoint) sends "refresh_token" as the grant, permanently bricking the integration until the user re-authorizes.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper forces `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` whenever the parsed payload lacks a refresh_token. In “sharing mode” it parses with `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, which does not include `refresh_token` and (without `.passthrough()`) will strip it even if present, so `.data.refresh_token` will always be missing and thus replaced with the literal placeholder. Callers then persist/merge this into the credential key (e.g. `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` and updates prisma), which would overwrite the real stored refresh_token with the placeholder and break subsequent refreshes until re-auth.
